correctness.rationale: For every one of the 25-site spin configurations of both graphs, two independent exhaustive counting algorithms agree cellwise on the full induced-edge histogram. Exact binomial moments give \(A_r=0\) for \(0\le r\le5\), \(A_6(y)=-4y^4(y-1)^4(y+1)^{13}\), \(A_7(y)=-24y^5(y-1)^2(y+1)^{11}(17y^3-15y^2-3y+3)\), and \(A_8(1)=-24576\). Algebra then proves the \(-48\,2^{25}J^8\beta^8\) leading difference for any fixed real field. The sharp clique-occupancy bound and independently counted optimizer multiplicities establish the zero-field low-temperature inversion and a crossing.

value.rationale: A natural, historically classified pair of nonisomorphic cospectral 25-vertex strongly regular graphs has seven identical high-temperature orders for all uniform magnetic fields but a sharp eighth-order split, with an unavoidable temperature-induced reversal. The exact eight-edge even-subgraph count and crossover existence are more discriminating than shared spectral parameters, published chromatic data or known minimum-energy plex counts; the finite fact provides a reproducible benchmark for statistical-mechanical graph distinguishability.
